headlines.title_en: Wallstreetcn Breakfast | September 10, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Oil breaks above $100 and ahead of inflation data, US stocks fall for a third day, Meta bucks the trend with a 6% jump, Treasuries decline across the board. A much-anticipated bold move falls flat as the US Treasury triples the size of its long-bond buyback, but the $6 billion comes in at the low end of expectations, and the 10-year Treasury yield rises above 4.84%, a new high since November 2023. Trump says the Iran conflict will end "immediately" after the US midterm elections. Iran announces a new maritime "sanctions zone" and attacks a US military base; US forces strike an Iranian oil tanker; escalating Middle East tensions push Brent crude above $100 for the first time in over a month, closing at $101.21. China's Ministry of Commerce: the US accusation of AI distillation is an attempt to pursue tech hegemony and monopolize computing power, and China firmly opposes it. China's August CPI rose 0.8% year-on-year, PPI rose 3.8% year-on-year, both turning positive month-on-month, amid international oil prices and seasonal food price increases.

headlines.title: 定向可转债市场化改革提速，在房地产行业应用场景有望进一步丰富
headlines.summary: 中国证监会8月底发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，支持上市房企通过向特定对象发行方式再融资，并支持上市房企综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产。从已发行案例看，定向可转债在并购重组中主要扮演兼具债底保护与股性弹性的创新支付工具角色。业内人士认为，在房地产领域，定向可转债此前主要承担项目融资功能，未来随着行业并购需求上升，其在房地产行业中的应用场景有望进一步丰富。业内人士表示，今年已披露预案的定向可转债已达12只，远高于去年同期，具备发行扩容的基础。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Market-based reform of targeted convertible bonds accelerates, application scenarios in the real estate sector expected to further expand
headlines.summary_en: At the end of August, the CSRC issued the "Opinions on Supporting the Building of a New Model for Real Estate Development in the Capital Market," supporting listed real estate developers in refinancing through targeted issuance to specific investors, and supporting them in using tools such as shares, targeted convertible bonds and cash to acquire real estate-related assets. Based on issued cases, targeted convertible bonds mainly play the role of an innovative payment instrument in M&A and restructuring that combines downside protection with equity-like flexibility. Industry insiders believe that in the real estate sector, targeted convertible bonds previously mainly served project financing, and as M&A demand in the industry rises, their application scenarios in real estate are expected to further broaden. Industry insiders say 12 targeted convertible bond plans have been disclosed so far this year, far above the same period last year, providing a basis for expanded issuance. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 第七、八期电子式储蓄国债今起发行
headlines.summary: 从今天开始，财政部将发行今年第七期和第八期电子式储蓄国债。其中，第七期期限3年，票面年利率为1.63%，最大发行额248亿元；第八期期限5年，票面年利率为1.7%，最大发行额302亿元。投资者可通过银行网点柜面和已开通的电子渠道购买，单一国债账户购买每期国债不得超过50万元。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Seventh and eighth tranches of electronic savings bonds begin issuance today
headlines.summary_en: Starting today, the Ministry of Finance will issue the seventh and eighth tranches of electronic savings treasury bonds this year. The seventh tranche has a 3-year term and a coupon rate of 1.63%, with a maximum issuance amount of RMB 24.8 billion; the eighth tranche has a 5-year term and a coupon rate of 1.7%, with a maximum issuance amount of RMB 30.2 billion. Investors can purchase them through bank counter channels and opened electronic channels, and purchases of each tranche through a single treasury bond account may not exceed RMB 500,000. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 上证报头版文章：中国资产“确定性”筑牢资本市场内在稳定性
headlines.summary: 近期，市场对“流动性”的讨论有所升温。从全球市场看，以美债为代表的多国国债收益率飙升，引发市场对流动性挤压的普遍担忧；从A股市场看，近两天成交额有所缩减，有声音解读为市场流动性趋紧的信号。多位市场专家接受采访认为，当前A股流动性仍处于健康区间，从长期看，中国经济及政策稳定性、科技创新加快引领产业格局变迁以及全球市场对中国资产安全性的认可，都将推动A股独立定价能力进一步夯实。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Securities News front-page article: "Certainty" of Chinese assets fortifies intrinsic stability of capital markets
headlines.summary_en: Recently, discussion of "liquidity" in the market has heated up. Globally, surging government bond yields in many countries, represented by US Treasuries, have triggered widespread concerns about a liquidity squeeze; in the A-share market, trading volume has shrunk somewhat in the past two days, which some have interpreted as a signal of tightening market liquidity. Several market experts said in interviews that current A-share liquidity remains in a healthy range, and in the long term, China's economic and policy stability, the accelerating leadership of technological innovation in changing the industrial landscape, and global recognition of the safety of Chinese assets will all further consolidate A-shares' independent pricing capacity.

headlines.title: 券商秋季策略会展望：A股“金秋行情”有望延续，扩散和均衡主导配置
headlines.summary: 金秋九月，2026年券商秋季策略会密集召开。截至9月9日，华福证券、西部证券、财通证券、天风证券等多家券商已召开秋季策略会。梳理发现，在外围市场不确定性延续的背景下，券商普遍对国内资本市场后市表现持积极态度。同时，券商投研重心已由上半年的科技“一枝独秀”明显转向“多元均衡”配置，大消费、地产链等板块的关注度显著回升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Brokerage autumn strategy meetings outlook: A-share "golden autumn rally" expected to continue, with diffusion and balance dominating allocation
headlines.summary_en: In golden September, 2026 autumn strategy meetings by brokerages are being held intensively. As of September 9, several brokerages including Huafu Securities, Western Securities, Caitong Securities and Tianfeng Securities have held autumn strategy meetings. A review shows that amid continued uncertainty in overseas markets, brokerages generally hold a positive view on the outlook for the domestic capital market. At the same time, brokerage research focus has clearly shifted from the "one standout" technology sector in the first half to "diversified and balanced" allocation, with attention to sectors such as major consumption and the real estate chain rising significantly. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 国家发展改革委举行与美在华企业高层圆桌会
headlines.summary: 今天（9月10日）上午，国家发展改革委与美在华跨国企业高层圆桌会在京举办，主题为“拥抱‘十五五’ 共谋新发展”。亚马逊云、英伟达、戴尔、霍尼韦尔（中国）有限公司等60余家来自科技算力、工业能源和消费医药等领域美在华企业代表参会。会上，国家发展改革委相关司局介绍“十五五”规划纲要有关政策考虑，“十五五”时期我国利用外资政策情况，新一轮大规模设备更新和消费品以旧换新政策有关实施成效，提振消费相关政策精神，相关负责人介绍发展北京市经济社会发展情况并推介北京市投资环境，跨国企业高层代表发言交流。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: National Development and Reform Commission holds high-level roundtable with U.S. companies in China
headlines.summary_en: This morning (September 10), the National Development and Reform Commission held a roundtable in Beijing with senior executives of US multinational companies in China, themed "Embracing the 15th Five-Year Plan, Seeking New Development Together." More than 60 representatives of US companies in China, including Amazon Cloud, Nvidia, Dell and Honeywell (China) Co., Ltd., from fields such as technology and computing power, industrial energy, and consumer and pharmaceuticals attended. At the meeting, relevant departments of the NDRC explained policy considerations related to the 15th Five-Year Plan outline, China's foreign investment utilization policy during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the implementation results of the new round of large-scale equipment upgrades and consumer goods trade-in policies, and the spirit of policies to boost consumption. Relevant officials introduced Beijing's economic and social development and promoted the city's investment environment, and senior executives of multinational companies spoke and exchanged views. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance plans second continuation issuance of 2026 ultra-long special treasury bonds (sixth tranche)
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance plans a second follow-on issuance of 2026 ultra-long special treasury bonds (sixth tranche). This follow-on issuance is a 30-year fixed-rate interest-bearing bond. The competitive bidding face value for this follow-on issuance totals RMB 73 billion, with no additional bidding by Class A members. The coupon rate for this follow-on issuance is the same as that of the previously issued bonds of the same tenor, at 2.14%. The interest accrual date and repayment arrangements are the same as those of the previously issued bonds of the same tenor. Interest starts accruing on August 15, 2026, with semiannual coupon payments on February 15 and August 15 each year (postponed for holidays, same below), and principal repayment plus the final interest payment on August 15, 2056. Bidding time is from 10:35 to 11:35 a.m. on September 16, 2026. Distribution will take place from the end of bidding to September 17, 2026, and from September 21 it will be combined with the previously issued bonds of the same tenor

headlines.title: 上海证券报头版：中国资产“确定性”筑牢资本市场内在稳定性
headlines.summary: 中国证监会8月底发布《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》，支持上市房企通过向特定对象发行方式再融资，并支持上市房企综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产。从已发行案例看，定向可转债在并购重组中主要扮演兼具债底保护与股性弹性的创新支付工具角色。业内人士认为，在房地产领域，定向可转债此前主要承担项目融资功能，未来随着行业并购需求上升，其在房地产行业中的应用场景有望进一步丰富。业内人士表示，今年已披露预案的定向可转债已达12只，远高于去年同期，具备发行扩容的基础。（上证报）

President Xi Jinping has repeatedly delivered important video addresses at the Global Services Trade Summit or sent congratulatory letters to the CIFTIS, announcing practical measures to deepen opening-up and cooperation in the services sector, fully demonstrating China's firm determination to expand high-level opening-up and its proactive responsibility in promoting the development of global services and services trade.
